name: Approved health education sessions delivered
numerator_definition: Distinct approved health education sessions actually delivered in the period with content-version and delivery evidence.
denominator_definition: Not applicable: count, not a population rate.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Exclude plans, duplicate broadcasts counted as the same session and unapproved messages. Sessions are not recipients, comprehension, clinical contacts or improved health outcomes. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Approved education content and session delivery register

name: Community interventions completed by deadline
numerator_definition: Accepted community interventions due in the period with evidence independently accepted complete by deadline.
denominator_definition: All accepted community interventions due in the period, including blocked and overdue work.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: A proposed, unowned or merely funded activity is not accepted completion. Exclusions and cancelled commitments require authority and remain disclosed. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Intervention commitments, due dates and independent completion reviews

name: Required demand areas with evidenced serviceability
numerator_definition: Required demand areas meeting the adopted serviceability standard at period end with reviewed capability and access evidence.
denominator_definition: All demand areas in the actual approved required-area inventory at period end.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: If the inventory or access standard is absent, report UNKNOWN. Facility counts or self-selected attendance cannot establish geographic reach. Do not sum as-of percentages over periods. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Approved area inventory, access standard and serviceability assessment
